technical.summary: Strong technical confluence with bullish momentum (RSI rising, MACD crossover, Hull flip, three white soldiers) but overbought conditions (Stoch 86.83, Williams %R) and negative CMF create entry risk; moderate swing setup requiring confirmation on pullback.

fundamental.summary: FDS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 10 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent recent congressional conviction and news data limits conviction; stale congressional trades (935+ days old) provide no current directional signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (290+), strong dollar pressures multinationals, CPI event imminent, and earnings binary in 10 days—financials sector particularly vulnerable to credit stress and rate volatility.
